symptoms: Battle screen during Pokemon combat: Game shows blank white screen and crashes completely when any damage calculation encounters an error or exception, causing the entire battle to become unusable

Battle results message display: All effectiveness messages show the exact same text as the first attack's message, with every battle result displaying identical effectiveness descriptions regardless of the actual type matchups
changes: Changed Promise wrapping to use Promise.all with results array instead of direct promise handling, causing execution to fail if damage calculation throws an error
Modified effectivenessMsg to map all items to the first item's value using results[0].effectivenessMsg instead of using the correct individual result
